title: What is the very first memory you can recall?
prompt: Describe what you remember, how old you think you were, and what made the moment memorable.

title: Tell us about the home you grew up in.
prompt: What did it look like? What sounds and smells do you associate with it? Where did you feel most comfortable?

title: What were your parents like when you were growing up?
prompt: What qualities do you remember most fondly about each of them?

title: What did an ordinary day look like when you were a child?
prompt: What were your responsibilities, routines and favourite ways to spend your time?

title: What is one childhood memory that still makes you smile?
prompt: It could be something funny, mischievous, exciting or seemingly insignificant.

title: What were you like as a teenager?
prompt: Were you adventurous, shy, mischievous, studious or something else entirely?

title: Who was your closest friend growing up?
prompt: Tell us about them and a memorable experience you shared.

title: What did you dream of becoming when you were young?
prompt: Did you have ambitions or plans for your future? How did they change?

title: What was something you enjoyed doing as a young person that you wish you could do again today?
prompt: Tell us what you loved about it.

title: What do you know about your grandparents and earlier generations of your family?
prompt: What stories were passed down to you?

title: Were there any particularly important family traditions when you were growing up?
prompt: How were they celebrated or observed?

title: What is something about your family history that you wish more people knew?
prompt: Share the story and tell us why it matters to you.

title: If you could spend one afternoon with a relative from an earlier generation, who would you choose?
prompt: What would you ask them?

title: How did you and your spouse first meet?
prompt: Where were you, what were the circumstances, and what was your first impression?

title: What do you remember most about the early days of your relationship?
prompt: What did you enjoy doing together?

title: What was your wedding day like?
prompt: What details, people or moments have stayed with you?

title: What do you think makes a lasting friendship or relationship?
prompt: Has your understanding changed over the years?

title: Who is someone outside your immediate family who had a particularly positive influence on your life?
prompt: What did they teach you?

title: What was your very first job?
prompt: How did you get it, what were your responsibilities, and what did you earn?

title: What was the most interesting or unusual job you ever had?
prompt: Tell us about a memorable experience from that time.

title: What achievement in your working life are you most proud of?
prompt: What made it meaningful?

title: If you could choose another career or profession to experience for a day, what would it be and why?
prompt: What interests you about it?

title: What major historical event do you remember most vividly?
prompt: Where were you when you heard about it, and how did it affect you?

title: How has the world changed most dramatically during your lifetime?
prompt: What changes have surprised you the most?

title: What invention or technological development has had the biggest impact on your everyday life?
prompt: What do you remember about life before it?

title: What was something about everyday life when you were young that would surprise someone growing up today?
prompt: Think about shopping, school, travel, entertainment or communication.

title: What is the most memorable trip or holiday you ever took?
prompt: What happened, who was with you, and why does it stand out?

title: Is there somewhere in the world you've always wanted to visit?
prompt: What attracts you to it?

title: Tell us about a time you did something completely outside your comfort zone.
prompt: How did it turn out?

title: What is one particularly funny, unexpected or unbelievable experience you've had?
prompt: The kind of story that deserves to be told at family gatherings.

title: What do you remember about becoming a parent for the first time?
prompt: What were you feeling and what surprised you?

title: What was your favourite part of raising a family?
prompt: What everyday moments do you remember most fondly?

title: What family holiday, celebration or gathering stands out most in your memory?
prompt: What made it special?

title: What is something your children did growing up that made you particularly proud or happy?
prompt: Tell us the story behind it.

title: What has been the most wonderful surprise about becoming a grandparent?
prompt: How is being a grandparent different from being a parent?

title: Which home you've lived in holds the most memories for you?
prompt: Tell us about the house, the neighbourhood and the people who filled it.

title: What meal or recipe reminds you most of your childhood?
prompt: Who made it, and do you still make it today? Include the recipe if you remember it.

title: What did Christmas look like in your younger years?
prompt: What traditions, decorations, foods and celebrations do you remember?

title: What is one simple everyday pleasure that has always made you happy?
prompt: It might be a favourite walk, a cup of tea, gardening or time with loved ones.

title: What music has accompanied the different stages of your life?
prompt: Is there a particular song that takes you back to a specific time?

title: What hobby, interest or pastime has brought you the most enjoyment?
prompt: How did you first discover it?

title: If you could become an expert in any subject or skill, what would you choose?
prompt: What would you enjoy learning?

title: What book, film, piece of music or work of art has stayed with you throughout your life?
prompt: Why has it been so memorable?

title: What period of your life do you look back on with the greatest fondness?
prompt: What made that particular chapter special?

title: What is something you understand about life now that you wish you had understood when you were younger?
prompt: What helped you learn it?

title: What is a decision you made that significantly shaped the direction of your life?
prompt: How might things have been different otherwise?

title: What personal quality or value has helped you most throughout your life?
prompt: Where do you think you learned it?

title: What does a happy and fulfilling life mean to you?
prompt: Has your definition changed over the years?

title: What are you most proud of when you look back on your life?
prompt: It doesn't have to be an achievement; it could be a relationship, a moment or a way you've lived.

title: What is something about yourself that you hope your grandchildren and future generations will understand?
prompt: Tell us why you want them to know it.

title: What advice would you give to someone just beginning their adult life?
prompt: What do you think they should remember?

title: If future generations could remember just three things about you, what would you want those things to be?
prompt: These might be values, stories, traditions or simple memories.
